# Ready-template previews

Every PNG in this folder was rendered locally from the corresponding unmodified
MIT TSCaps CSS template and the MIT `@tscaps/engine` browser renderer. They are
not hand-drawn examples or screenshots of a different subtitle engine.

The neutral background contains no user footage. It exists only so the style,
font, animation frame, placement, and colour treatment can be compared safely.

`manifest-previews.json` records the render result for all twelve chosen
templates. `preview-input.mp4` and `preview-captions.srt` are the neutral local
fixtures used for the check. The source templates and MIT notices are one level
up; font faces and OFL notices are in `static/ready-captions/`.
